faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: No. Money goes directly to the school's bank or Mobile Money account. PAYSKOOL is a subscription service: we never collect or hold your funds. You connect your own Mobile Money accounts, and payments arrive directly to you.
faq.q2: What if our parents still pay in cash at the counter?
faq.a2: Our Cash Desk module lets you collect cash in 5 seconds with immediate receipt generation. Every transaction is timestamped and tracked, eliminating any risk of cash discrepancies. The receipt is instantly sent to the parent via WhatsApp.
faq.q3: How long does it take to get started?
faq.a3: Under 2 hours. You import your student lists in minutes from your usual Excel file. Connecting your Mobile Money accounts is guided step by step. Our team supports you until your first collection.
faq.q4: Do parents need to install an app?
faq.a4: No. The parent portal opens directly in the phone's browser, with nothing to download. It works on all Internet-connected phones, even basic ones. Login is done via SMS or WhatsApp code.
faq.a5: Wave, Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, CinetPay and Paystack. As well as cash and cheque payments through our Cash Desk module. We regularly add new payment methods based on our schools' needs.

about.heroTitle: Building the financial future of education in Africa
about.heroSubtitle: Payskool was born from a profound conviction: the quality of education depends on the financial strength of the institutions that provide it. We give promoters absolute control over their cash flow.
about.manifestoP1: Running a school today is a constant challenge. Beyond educational excellence, promoters and founders face a complex reality on the ground: the archaic management of financial flows. Between the burden of handling cash, the risk of funds evaporating at the counter, and the tedious management of fake payment slips, leaders' energy is too often absorbed by administrative tasks instead of being invested in growth.
about.manifestoP2: Worse still, this financial opacity isolates institutions. Without a certified and unalterable revenue history, it becomes extremely difficult to prove solvency to banking partners. The result? Credit refusals or unsuitable financing conditions, which hinder or completely block expansion projects, the purchase of school buses, or the modernization of classrooms.
about.manifestoP3: It is against this backdrop that Payskool was created. We have brought together a team of experts in finance and educational management to build the benchmark platform dedicated to the African school ecosystem. More than just a collection solution, Payskool acts as the true trusted ally of promoters, transforming cash management into a powerful lever for peace of mind and development.
about.commitmentsTitle: Our commitments to the educational ecosystem
about.commitment1Desc: We put an end to the evaporation of funds. Every franc collected, whether at the counter or via Mobile Money, is timestamped, tracked, and recorded in an unalterable ledger. With Payskool, the tolerance for cash leakage is zero. Your financial data is encrypted and protected.
about.commitment2Desc: Designed 100% for the reality on the ground in Africa, our platform integrates natively with Mobile Money operators and local banking networks. We offer parents a smooth and frictionless payment experience, respecting their habits and guaranteeing transaction speed.
about.commitment3Desc: We give control back to leaders. With live visibility into cash flow and collections, promoters make informed decisions with total peace of mind. No more gray areas and nasty accounting surprises at the end of the month.
about.commitment4Desc: Our mission goes beyond securing payments. By certifying your regular revenue streams, Payskool provides you with a true passport to credit. We actively support you in financing your infrastructure by strengthening your credibility with lending institutions.
about.impact1Desc: The integrity of your revenue is guaranteed, every transaction is certified and unforgeable.
about.impact2Desc: The average collection level observed by our partner institutions in their first year.
about.impact3Desc: The volume of management, reconciliation, and paperwork hours saved by your administrative teams.
about.impact4Desc: Maximum availability of our platform to ensure continuous service.
about.ctaTitle: Let's build the school of tomorrow together.
about.ctaDesc: The independence and growth of your institution begin with serene and controlled financial management. Let's discuss your current challenges and discover how Payskool can secure and transform your daily life.

careers.heroTitle: Join the mission. Let's secure education in Africa.
careers.heroSubtitle: At Payskool, we don't just build collection software. We build the financial infrastructure that enables private schools to grow with peace of mind and shape the future of millions of students.
careers.cultureIntro: We are a team of builders. We combine the technical excellence of the world's top Fintechs with a deep and authentic understanding of African realities on the ground.
careers.culture1Desc: What you code, design, or sell today saves a school's cash flow tomorrow. At Payskool, your work doesn't get lost in a backlog: it has a tangible and immediate impact on the survival of educational institutions.
careers.culture2Desc: We manage the financial flows of education. Approximation is not an option; rigor is our foundation. We make no compromises on the security and reliability of our systems.
careers.culture3Desc: We master the complex reality of Mobile Money and cash payments in Africa, and we bring the most advanced software architectures on the market to it.
careers.culture4Desc: Like our product, our internal culture values clarity. Information flows freely, successes are celebrated as a team, and failures are our best learning opportunities.
careers.perksIntro: To solve complex problems, you need a free mind. We take care of our team so they can give their best.
careers.perk1Desc: Remote-friendly policy or hybrid work: choose the environment where you perform best.
careers.perk2Desc: Latest generation MacBook Pro provided from your first day, so your tools match your talent.
careers.perk3Desc: Top-tier premium health coverage for you and your family. Your peace of mind is our priority.

fullstack.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (NestJS / React)
fullstack.aboutText: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to lead the development of our collection and financing platform. You will be responsible for designing robust architectures capable of securely processing millions of financial transactions.
fullstack.resp1: Design and develop new features in TypeScript (NestJS, React, Prisma).
fullstack.resp2: Ensure the security, performance, and reliability of the platform handling high transaction volumes.
fullstack.resp3: Mentor team engineers and spread technical best practices.
fullstack.req1: 5+ years of full-stack development experience (Node.js/NestJS, React, TypeScript).
fullstack.req2: Significant experience in designing financial (Fintech) or transactional applications.
fullstack.req3: Excellent mastery of PostgreSQL and complex data modeling.
fullstack.ben2: Premium equipment (MacBook Pro) and top-tier health insurance.

product-designer.title: Fintech UX/UI Product Designer
product-designer.aboutText: You will be the guardian of the user experience on Payskool. Your mission: transform complex financial flows into simple, reassuring, and extremely intuitive interfaces for school promoters and parents.
product-designer.resp1: Design user journeys from A to Z (Wireframes, Prototypes, High-Fidelity Mockups on Figma).
product-designer.resp2: Maintain and enrich our B2B Design System.
product-designer.resp3: Conduct user research and usability testing with our clients (school directors, cashiers).

product-designer.req2: Ability to popularize complexity: you know how to turn a financial dashboard into a clear experience.
product-designer.req3: Excellent mastery of Figma and accessibility best practices.
product-designer.ben1: Major impact on a product used by dozens of schools.
